description: Voltage traces for one C-neuron model (the best-scoring candidate, id 1035, J = 2.521; it does NOT meet the calibration targets). Time in ms from the start of the run (stimulation starts at 200 ms); voltage in mV rounded to 0.1, sampled every 1 ms (a 1 ms spike is under-sampled: this file shows slow state, not spike shapes). Model units; intracellular current injected at the mid-stem of a simplified model, not a clinical amplitude or a stimulation setting. stim_times are the 1 ms pulses at the mid-stem; test_times are the peripheral probe pulses (2 Hz mean).
